A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed method can improve the transcription accuracy for piano music in the studio setting by up to 5 percentage points compared to a baseline system, and that the proposed transcription framework can be used to improve the performance of other transcription systems by up to 4 percentage points.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in addition to the instrument type, also the recording scenario plays an important role in determining the performance of automatic transcription systems.
the performance of state-of-the-art methods can be improved substantially by exploiting additional information available on the recording setup.
